description: A pair of dependent select dropdowns where the child options are loaded asynchronously based on the selected parent value. When the parent changes, the child value is automatically reset and LoadChildOptionsAsync is called. The child select is disabled while the parent is empty or children are loading. Fully generic — TParent and TChild can be any type supported by TmSelect.

parameters.name: ParentValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the parent selection changes.

parameters.name: ParentError
parameters.description: Validation error for the parent select.

parameters.name: ChildValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the child selection changes.

parameters.name: LoadChildOptionsAsync
parameters.description: Async callback that loads child options based on the selected parent. Receives the current ParentValue (may be null when parent is cleared).

parameters.name: ChildPlaceholder
parameters.description: Placeholder for the child select when a parent is selected.

parameters.name: ChildError
parameters.description: Validation error for the child select.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the root element.

examples.title: Region → City (async data)
examples.code:
<TmCascadingSelect TParent="string" TChild="string"
    ParentLabel="Region"
    ChildLabel="City"
    ParentOptions="@_regionOptions"
    ParentPlaceholder="Select region..."
    ChildPlaceholder="Select city..."
    @bind-ParentValue="_region"
    @bind-ChildValue="_city"
    LoadChildOptionsAsync="LoadCitiesAsync" />

@code {
    private string? _region;
    private string? _city;

    private async Task<IReadOnlyList<SelectOption<string>>> LoadCitiesAsync(string? region)
    {
        if (region is null) return [];
        var cities = await _locationService.GetCitiesAsync(region);
        return cities.Select(c => new SelectOption<string>(c.Id, c.Name)).ToList();
    }
}
